question: Why was APAC's marketing spend so much lower in 2025 than in 2024?

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT m.channel, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.month LIKE '2024%' THEN m.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS spend_2024, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.month LIKE '2025%' THEN m.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS spend_2025, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.month LIKE '2025%' THEN m.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN m.month LIKE '2024%' THEN m.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS spend_change FROM marketing_spend AS m JOIN regions AS r ON r.region_id = m.region_id WHERE r.region_name = 'APAC' GROUP BY m.channel ORDER BY spend_change ASC LIMIT 500

answer: APAC's marketing spend decreased across all channels in 2025, driven primarily by a reduction of 69,630.40 in Direct spend (from 217,971.33 in 2024 to 148,340.93 in 2025) and a reduction of 36,992.74 in Partner spend (from 199,937.33 in 2024 to 162,944.59 in 2025). Online marketing spend also declined, but by a smaller amount of 3,268.14 (from 199,580.97 to 196,312.83).
